prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Edit image 1, the existing single-field main page, into a revised high-fidelity landscape Chinese cultivation game UI.
Image 2 is the actual 善功堂 game screenshot, STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its grey-brown connected timber framing, warm ivory paper, sparse blue-grey paper-edge wash, dark ordinary Kaiti gameplay text and quiet framed paper buttons. Do not copy its roof, building, flowers, hanging signs, four catalogue columns or background.

The user's NEW corrections are:
“左边这个太大了不需要，其次，没有切换按钮吗？右边这些信息可以显示详细一点。”
Three mandatory changes:
1. Drastically reduce the left field from about 67% to about 38% of the body width. Right information area grows to about 62%. The field remains visible, but is no longer an enormous empty main canvas.
2. Add highly visible field-switch controls: previous field, current-field dropdown and next field, in the header.
3. Make the right information considerably more detailed and readable: target plant and current state, environment/current/required/judgment/concrete reason table, then concise current gaps and prospective effects. Do not fill the extra space with ornamental blank paper.

PRESERVE:
One field per page. Exactly ONE field shown. Strict top-down ground view, original common baseline soil, unplanted state, target 月露苔. No player character, no multiple-field map, no subplots, no capacity number.
Keep the reference game family: a shallow connected grey-brown wooden rim and divider, warm-paper information sheet, subdued blue-grey corner details, readable dark Kaiti/slab Chinese, restrained corner/landscape ornament.
Adding materials and modification controls remain in a CLOSED management subpage. On this main page show only “管理田地” as its entry. No bottom workbench, material slots, inventory, plus-slot, material list, temperature/water/light/spirit control tabs, numerical sliders, effect preview or payment/confirmation buttons. No management-page inset.

NEW COMPOSITION:
Slim connected timber and paper header about 9% image height.
At left modest heading “瑶圃峰 · 灵圃”.
Centered clearly visible navigation, each with proper button affordance:
“上一块” with left arrow (disabled grey because current is first),
current-field dropdown “一号田” with downward triangle,
“下一块” with right arrow (active).
At far right small framed paper “返回田地”.
Do not hide navigation in tiny glyphs or solely at outer screen edges. Current field name must match all page context. No fake “1/6” fixed field count.

Body is exactly TWO side-by-side connected areas, spanning the remaining height:
LEFT approximately 38%, RIGHT approximately 62%, no lower full-width panel.
Left: compact paper heading “田地”, small “未定植” marker. One continuous rectangular soft grey-brown hand-painted soil field occupies its own left region, not a giant image across two thirds of the canvas. Vertical orthographic ground, faint shallow furrow brush marks, sparse subtle grass only at earthen perimeter, no rocks, pond, shade tree, planted crop or natural advantage.
Short factual caption under field: “原有土层：普通土层”. No control tabs or crop inventory on this side.

RIGHT: spacious well typeset warm-paper information page:
Top line large enough to read but not oversized: “灵草与环境”.
Next line target selector “目标灵草：月露苔” with tiny down triangle, and separate understated state “未定植”. This is a target for an empty field, not an existing crop.
No large portrait.

Below, section heading “环境与需求对照”.
Table with FIVE clearly aligned columns, ample width, horizontal rules, readable regular Chinese, no dense dark cell grid:
“条件” | “地块当前” | “灵草需求” | “判定” | “具体原因”
Exactly these five rows, maintaining verbatim text:
“温度” | “偏暖” | “凉润” | “偏高” | “温度高于适生要求”
“灵力浓度” | “偏低” | “充足” | “不足” | “环境灵力尚不充足”
“水分” | “湿润” | “湿润” | “满足” | “干湿条件符合需求”
“光照” | “直射” | “遮阴” | “过强” | “当前直射，缺少遮阴”
“土层” | “普通土层” | “阴湿岩面” | “不符” | “尚缺所需附着岩面”
Use small muted terracotta crosses beside unmet judgments and a subdued sage check beside satisfied water; keep judgment words so meaning never depends on color.
Do not shrink the text into tiny print. Widen the table and keep all columns visible; wrap a reason only if needed, do not overlap.

Below table, two compact text blocks with modest headings:
Heading “定植前需处理”
Text “温度、灵力、光照及土层尚未满足需求。”
Heading “不适影响”
Text “定植后若持续不适，会长慢、停长；”
Text “持续严重不适才受损或枯死。”
This is a FUTURE conditional explanation, not actual damage to an unplanted field. Do not show damaged-plant badges, growth bars, countdown, crop age or harvest button.

At lower right of this SAME right information sheet, one clear warm-paper button “管理田地”. No text explaining implementation beneath it.

SEMANTIC/ART LIMITS:
No invented numeric temperature, thresholds, spiritual-density percentage, costs, rates, inventory, yields or timers. Keep qualitative values, do not use fake placeholders like 0 or ??.
Do not use the word 基质, do not put additive recipes on the main page.
No copied shop background or roof, no new room or architecture, no isometric view, no neon grass, photoreal pebbles, gold glare, glow, fog, bloom, watermark, developer labels or notes.
Do not revert to the previous 2/3-width field or restore its empty wide footer.
Final check: left is COMPACT around 38%, right is DETAILED around 62%; obvious 上一块 / 一号田 dropdown / 下一块 switching; exactly one field; actual-vs-required conditions and concrete causes readable; effects correctly conditional because not planted; 管理田地 only, all modification operations remain in its closed subpage. Render one complete polished screen.
